question: Does the fixed recruitment-ligand transcript contrast retain a useful measured comparison after accounting for source coverage and model dependence?
scope: Independent peer diagnostic after RNA/array results; no hypothesis novelty claim, target selection or new source retrieval. Final endorsement waits for complete all12 TempO stage and coverage/value assessment.
prospective_diagnostics_for_review: Verify source/row/score arithmetic, all13EMC/46comparators and six arrayEMC; recompute unadjusted and full fixed model; show each existing single content covariate and all pairs, matched nine primary nonoverlap and RNA LGFMS-only sensitivity. Decompose fixed ligand numerator and denominator under same full design to detect regression suppression/ratio interpretation. Diagnostic alternatives cannot rescue a failed claim.
strongest_alternative: Bulk admixture and noisy content covariates, comparator histology/cohort/batch, overlap, platform probe baseline or source mapping account for a conditional contrast. Conditional coefficients do not demonstrate recruitment or tumor-cell secretion.
stage_review: All12 completion/hash/read accounting, exact-probe ambiguity and gene coverage, masked 9500-gene calibration including crosssample controls, relevant target count uncertainty and filtered missingness. Failed estimator benchmark is not biological absence/assay failure.
value: Prior published macrophage/infiltration contrasts do not make reanalysis new; precision and useful mechanistic differentiation require complete prior-art and eligible public EMC coverage.
